title: Dual-Anchor Acceleration Is Near-Optimal for Stochastic Monotone Root-Finding
abstract: arXiv:2609.36033v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Among distinct optimal acceleration mechanisms for deterministic monotone root-finding problems and fixed-point problems, dual-anchoring has recently been shown to admit a more robust direct stochastic extension than standard anchor acceleration. However, without additional strong monotonicity, the existing stochastic dual-anchoring guarantee has two limitations: first, it requires cocoercivity in expectation, and second, it attains only $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ oracle complexity, leaving a gap to the near-optimal $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ complexity achieved by other methods. translated_title: 双锚点加速对随机单调求根问题是接近最优的
translated_abstract: 在确定性单调求根问题与不动点问题的诸多最优加速机制中，双锚点加速最近被证明比标准锚点加速具有更稳健的直接随机化扩展。然而，在缺乏额外强单调性条件的情况下，现有的随机双锚点保证存在两个局限：其一，它要求期望意义下的余强制性；其二，它仅能达到 $O(\epsilon^{-3})$ 的预言机复杂度，与其他方法所达到的近最优 $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 复杂度之间存在差距。在本工作中，我们通过将双锚点加速与随机预解式逼近以及优化方差控制相结合，同时解决了这两个局限。对于方差以 $\sigma^2$ 为界的无偏随机预言机，其中样本算子单调且一致满足 $L$-Lipschitz 条件，我们的算法以接近最优的预言机复杂度找到一个 $\epsilon$-残差点（摘要原文在此处截断）。
tldr: 本文将双锚点加速与随机预解式逼近及优化的方差控制相结合，在无需强单调性且无需期望余强制性的条件下，将随机单调求根问题的预言机复杂度改进到接近最优的 $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ 量级。
en_tdlr: By combining dual-anchoring with stochastic resolvent approximation and optimized variance control, this paper achieves near-optimal $\tilde{O}(\epsilon^{-2})$ oracle complexity for stochastic monotone root-finding without requiring strong monotonicity or cocoercivity in expectation.
